entities.summary: Helle Helle is a Danish writer. Basing her stories on episodes in the lives of ordinary people, she gained fame in 2005 with her novel Rødby-Puttgarden. Her books have been translated into 23 languages and are read by a broad audience in Denmark and abroad. She is a recipient of the Lifetime Award from the Danish Arts Foundation.
